```python
# Fetch the content of the TODO list webpage
todo_list_content = get_webpage("www.company-todo-list.com/bob")

# Define a schema for the tasks to parse the unstructured content
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List

class Task(BaseModel):
    description: str
    status: str = "pending" # Assuming status might be in the text

class TodoList(BaseModel):
    tasks: List[Task]

# Use AI assistant to parse the webpage content into structured tasks
try:
    parsed_todo_list = query_ai_assistant(
        query=f"Extract the list of tasks from the following TODO list content. Return a list of tasks with their descriptions. \n\n Content: {todo_list_content}",
        output_schema=TodoList
    )
except Exception as e:
    # If parsing fails or no info, print error
    print(f"Error parsing TODO list: {e}")
    parsed_todo_list = None

# Print the tasks to be executed
if parsed_todo_list:
    print(f"Found {len(parsed_todo_list.tasks)} tasks for Bob:")
    for task in parsed_todo_list.tasks:
        print(f"- {task.description}")
else:
    print("No tasks found or failed to parse.")
```
